blurb: Guests can join a brewery tour to learn about the brewing process and see how the brewery is retrofitted. Tours include four beer samples. The brewery also offers online sales with free delivery in Ottawa and shipping across Ontario.
extraNote: Deliveries must be accepted by persons 19 years of age or older · Reservations accepted for groups up to 5pm when possible, not during events or live music · Walk-ins are always welcome · At the brewery in Orleans
